records.rule: Renewed numbering configuration and sequence are the only number source; Classic PAT_ID/OpdNo/OriginalOpd are prohibited.
Hash effective prefix, pattern, width, reset period, timezone, supported placeholders and active period at every dry-run/commit; stop on drift.
Pattern contains SEQUENCE exactly once, uses supported placeholders, is injective within period and fits target width.
Lock and resolve protected source crosswalk before any allocation; successful mapping returns existing target/number with zero sequence mutation.
Mapping reservation, sequence increment, patient insert, migration audit and crosswalk success share one transaction or reviewed equivalent protocol.
Lock exact (prefix,period_type,period_key); missing-row creation uses duplicate-key retry/upsert-and-lock, not check-then-insert only.
Check all live/soft-deleted/merged patients, archived numbers and aliases; stop on collision. Random suffix/decorating is prohibited.
Allocate/reserve nothing; output symbolic TARGET_GENERATED_AT_COMMIT and capacity/invariant aggregates only.
Allocate only after entity eligibility and target preflight pass; existing-target links and quarantined rows allocate zero.
Crosswalk is authoritative after crash/checkpoint lag; never allocate a replacement number.
Precommit failure rolls back sequence/patient/mapping together. After commit never decrement, recycle, delete/recreate or replace the number.
Pin active UTC period; close/reconcile and start a new run coordinate before crossing reset boundary.
Use same sequence lock as operations plus exact unified allocation ledger, otherwise require operational registration freeze.
Under freeze: S_after-S_before = migration_committed + explained_consumptions; expected explained_consumptions=0.
Without freeze: S_after-S_before = migration_committed + operational_committed + explained_consumptions; stop if operational_committed is not exactly ledgered.
PatientService::create unchanged, Patient::generatePatientNumber, GeneratesNumbers and uniqid collision suffix are unreachable from migration.
Stop on config drift, sequence underflow/overflow, coordinate multiplicity, collision, period crossing, non-atomic outcome, missing crosswalk or rerun allocation.
Classic keys/numbers reused=0; duplicate generated numbers=0; successful source with >1 target number=0; replacement numbers on rerun=0.
